evals.name: repository-gates primary scenario
evals.prompt: What gates apply to this repository before I can publish a PR for a Wave 2 Linear-issue branch? Resolve the repository policy profile and discover the actual configured gates.
evals.expected_output: Resolves repository_policy.provider_profile from versioned-configuration.json (merged with any local override) before anything else; discovers gates from real repo config (.pre-commit-config.yaml, branch protection, workflow files) rather than assuming a universal list; never invents a 'Review Changes' gate; discloses ambiguity if branch protection can't be read rather than treating that as 'no protection'.
